about.bioP1: Full Stack Developer with hands-on experience maintaining and scaling web platforms in production. Developed modules for events, checkout, waitlists, and API integrations with Asaas and WhatsApp at Evento Santo & Doar Digital.
about.bioP2: I work with PHP, CodeIgniter, Laravel, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, and C++. I build personal projects with automations, IoT, and AI agents. I also have practical background in home automation and IoT with ESP32, sensors, actuators, and electronics from hardware assembly to field installation.
about.bioP3: Always eager to learn and adapt to emerging technologies. I thrive on challenges and crafting innovative solutions for complex software problems.
